_comment: アシスタントのツールの台帳。Claude に渡すツール定義の正本で、Python 側 (backend/assistant.py) がそのまま渡す。画面側 (web-ui/src/lib/assistant-tools.ts) は、同じ名前の実行する関数を持つ (名前の過不足はテストで止める)。変えたら ASSISTANT_VERSION を上げる。設計は docs/assistant-design.md。

tools.name: get_project
tools.label: プロジェクトの様子を見る
tools.description: Read the current state of the project: tempo, time signature, steps per bar, song length, every track (id, name, role, mute/solo/gain/pan, note count, audio clips with their clip index, position and length, plus, for a trimmed clip, audio_start_seconds and audio_duration_seconds (where in its audio the clip starts and how long that audio is) and, for a faded clip, fade_in_seconds / fade_out_seconds, whether it has reference notes), which track is open in the piano roll, whether playback is running and where, the metronome, whether a song chart exists, the practice view and its settings (loop range, speed, what is heard), the notes the user has selected in the piano roll (selection: when the user says "here", "this part" or "the selected notes", they mean these), how far the user is in the learning flow (learn), the project name and whether it has unsaved changes, and any long-running job. Call this first whenever you need a track id or do not yet know what the project contains. Track ids are only valid for this session; never guess one.

tools.name: get_notes
tools.label: ノートを読む
tools.description: Read the notes of one track. Positions are in steps: one step is a 16th note, step 0 is the start of bar 1, and steps_per_bar comes from get_project. step and length can be decimals: 0.5 is a 32nd note, 1.3333 (4/3) an 8th-note triplet, 0.6667 (2/3) a 16th-note triplet; swung notes also sit between 16th notes. Each note is {pitch, step, length, velocity}; notes the user has selected in the piano roll also carry selected: true. Use source "reference" to read the reference notes (お手本: the transcription of the original song for that part) instead of the user's own notes. Optionally limit to a bar range (1-based, inclusive), or to the selected notes. At most 400 notes are returned; if the result says truncated, narrow the bar range. To find where the user's notes differ from the reference, use check_diff instead of reading both and comparing them yourself.

source.description: "notes" (default) for the user's notes, "reference" for the reference notes.

start_bar.description: First bar to include (1-based). Omit to start from bar 1.

end_bar.description: Last bar to include (1-based, inclusive). Omit to read to the end.

selected_only.description: true to return only the notes selected in the piano roll.

tools.name: get_chart
tools.label: カルテを読む
tools.description: Read the song chart (カルテ) that bunri computed from the imported song: key, chord progression by bar, and sections (intro, verse, chorus...) with their bar ranges. Returns an error if no song has been imported yet. Use it when the user asks about the song's key, chords or structure, or when you need them to place notes that fit the song.

tools.name: play
tools.label: 再生する
tools.description: Start playback. With from_bar, playback starts at the beginning of that bar (1-based); without it, playback continues from the current position.

tools.name: stop
tools.label: 停止する
tools.description: Stop playback and return the play position to the start.

tools.name: seek
tools.label: 小節へ移動する
tools.description: Move the play position to the start of a bar (1-based) and scroll the timeline and piano roll there. Does not start playback.

tools.name: set_tempo
tools.label: テンポを変える
tools.description: Set the project tempo in BPM (20 to 300). This changes how fast notes play; audio clips are not stretched.

bpm.description: Tempo in beats per minute, 20 to 300.

tools.name: set_time_signature
tools.label: 拍子を変える
tools.description: Set the time signature. 4 means 4/4, 3 means 3/4, 6 means 6/8. This changes steps_per_bar, so read get_project again before converting bars to steps.

tools.name: add_track
tools.label: トラックを追加する
tools.description: Add a new empty track and open it in the piano roll. Returns the new track's id. Omit name to get the default name (Track N).

tools.name: rename_track
tools.label: トラックの名前を変える
tools.description: Rename a track.

tools.name: delete_track
tools.label: トラックを削除する
tools.description: Delete a track with all of its notes and clips. The user can undo it, but only delete a track when the user asked for that track to be removed.

tools.name: select_track
tools.label: トラックを開く
tools.description: Open a track in the piano roll so the user sees its notes. Note tools work on any track by id, so this is only needed to show the user where you are working.

tools.name: set_track_mix
tools.label: ミュート・ソロ・音量・パンを変える
tools.description: Change a track's mute, solo, volume or pan. Give only the fields you want to change. gain_db is the volume in decibels from -60 to 6 (0 is unchanged level). pan is -1 (left) to 1 (right).

tools.name: add_notes
tools.label: ノートを置く
tools.description: Add notes to a track, keeping the notes that are already there. A note is {pitch, step, length, velocity}: pitch is a note name with octave such as "C4" or "F#3" (C4 is middle C, octaves 0 to 8); step is the start position in steps from the start of bar 1 (1 step = a 16th note; bar b starts at (b - 1) * steps_per_bar); length is the duration in steps (a quarter note is 4); both may be decimals (0.5 = a 32nd note, 4/3 = 1.3333 = an 8th-note triplet, 2/3 = 0.6667 = a 16th-note triplet; the three notes of an 8th-note triplet on beat 1 start at 0, 1.3333 and 2.6667) and are rounded to 1/60 of a step; velocity is 1 to 127 and may be omitted for the default (96). A note identical in pitch and step to an existing one is not added twice. Up to 512 notes per call. To change existing notes, use replace_notes instead.

step.description: Start in steps from the start of bar 1. 1 step = a 16th note. Decimals allowed: 0.5 = a 32nd note, 4/3 (1.3333) = an 8th-note triplet.

length.description: Duration in steps (quarter note = 4). Decimals allowed: 0.5 = a 32nd note, 4/3 (1.3333) = an 8th-note triplet. At least 0.25.

tools.name: remove_notes
tools.label: ノートを消す
tools.description: Remove the notes of a track that start inside a step range [start_step, end_step) (end exclusive). With pitches, only notes of those pitches are removed. With selected_only, the notes selected in the piano roll are removed and the range may be omitted. Use get_notes first so you know what the range contains.

start_step.description: First step of the range (1 step = a 16th note; decimals allowed).

end_step.description: End of the range (exclusive; decimals allowed). A note that starts exactly here is not in the range.

pitches.description: Only remove these pitches, e.g. ["C4", "E4"]. Omit to remove every pitch.

selected_only.description: true to remove only the notes selected in the piano roll. start_step and end_step may then be omitted.

tools.name: replace_notes
tools.label: ノートを置き換える
tools.description: Replace the notes of a track inside a step range [start_step, end_step) (end exclusive): every note that starts in the range is removed, then the given notes are added. Notes outside the range are untouched. Use this to rewrite a passage note by note (re-voicing, changing lengths, a different rhythm): read it with get_notes, then write back the changed version of the same range. For a uniform change, use the dedicated tools instead, which need no note list: transpose_notes, shift_notes, quantize_notes, repeat_notes, set_velocity. The given notes must start inside the range. Note format is the same as add_notes.

start_step.description: First step of the range (1 step = a 16th note; decimals allowed).

end_step.description: End of the range (exclusive; decimals allowed). A note that starts exactly here is not in the range.

step.description: Start in steps from the start of bar 1. 1 step = a 16th note. Decimals allowed: 0.5 = a 32nd note, 4/3 (1.3333) = an 8th-note triplet.

length.description: Duration in steps (quarter note = 4). Decimals allowed: 0.5 = a 32nd note, 4/3 (1.3333) = an 8th-note triplet. At least 0.25.

tools.name: open_practice
tools.label: 練習画面を開く
tools.description: Open the practice view (練習画面) for a part: the user's practice track for that part opens with the reference notes overlaid, so the user can enter notes and compare. track_id must be a part track (role "part" in get_project). Returns an error if the song has not been split into parts yet.

tools.name: close_practice
tools.label: 練習画面を閉じる
tools.description: Close the practice view and return to the arrangement.

tools.name: midi_input
tools.label: MIDI 入力を切り替える
tools.description: Connect or disconnect the MIDI keyboard input, and choose how played notes are recorded: "off" only sounds the notes, "step" places one note per key press and advances, "realtime" records what is played while playback runs. The result lists the keyboards that were found. The user plays the keyboard; you cannot play it.

mode.description: Recording mode to set after connecting. Omit to keep the current mode.

tools.name: transpose_notes
tools.label: ノートを移調する
tools.description: Transpose notes by a number of semitones without rewriting them (12 is one octave up, -12 one octave down). Which notes: those that start in [start_step, end_step) (end exclusive; omit both for the whole track), optionally only certain pitches, or only the notes selected in the piano roll (selected_only). Fails if a note would leave the range C0 to B8.

start_step.description: First step of the range (1 step = a 16th note; decimals allowed). Omit (with end_step) for the whole track.

end_step.description: End of the range (exclusive; decimals allowed). A note that starts exactly here is not in the range.

pitches.description: Only these pitches, e.g. ["C4", "E4"]. Omit for every pitch.

selected_only.description: true to change only the notes selected in the piano roll.

tools.name: shift_notes
tools.label: ノートをずらす
tools.description: Move notes earlier or later in time by a number of steps (a beat is 4 steps, a bar is steps_per_bar; decimals allowed, e.g. 0.5 for a 32nd note or 1.3333 for one 8th-note triplet). Positive moves later. Which notes: those that start in [start_step, end_step) (end exclusive; omit both for the whole track), optionally only certain pitches, or only the notes selected in the piano roll (selected_only).

start_step.description: First step of the range (1 step = a 16th note; decimals allowed). Omit (with end_step) for the whole track.

end_step.description: End of the range (exclusive; decimals allowed). A note that starts exactly here is not in the range.

pitches.description: Only these pitches, e.g. ["C4", "E4"]. Omit for every pitch.

selected_only.description: true to change only the notes selected in the piano roll.

steps.description: Steps to move; positive is later, negative is earlier. Decimals allowed: 0.5 = a 32nd note, 4/3 (1.3333) = one 8th-note triplet.

tools.name: quantize_notes
tools.label: ノートの位置をそろえる
tools.description: Snap note starts to a grid, given as the grid size in steps: 0.5 = 32nd notes, 1 = 16th notes, 2 = 8th notes, 4 = quarter notes, 8 = half notes, 16 = whole notes, and for triplets 1.3333 (4/3) = 8th-note triplets, 0.6667 (2/3) = 16th-note triplets. Notes can sit between 16th notes (32nd notes, triplets, swung or freely played notes), so the 16th grid is a real choice: use it to pull such notes onto 16th notes, and use a triplet grid to pull a straight rhythm onto triplets. With lengths: true, lengths are also rounded to the grid. Which notes: those that start in [start_step, end_step) (end exclusive; omit both for the whole track), optionally only certain pitches, or only the notes selected in the piano roll (selected_only).

start_step.description: First step of the range (1 step = a 16th note; decimals allowed). Omit (with end_step) for the whole track.

end_step.description: End of the range (exclusive; decimals allowed). A note that starts exactly here is not in the range.

pitches.description: Only these pitches, e.g. ["C4", "E4"]. Omit for every pitch.

selected_only.description: true to change only the notes selected in the piano roll.

grid_steps.description: Grid size in steps. One of: 0.5 (32nd notes), 0.6667 (16th-note triplets, 2/3), 1 (16th notes), 1.3333 (8th-note triplets, 4/3), 2 (8th notes), 4 (quarter notes), 8 (half notes), 16 (whole notes).

lengths.description: true to also round note lengths to the grid.

tools.name: repeat_notes
tools.label: ノートをくり返して置く
tools.description: Copy the notes that start in [start_step, end_step) and place the copies later in the same track, times times in a row. The range length is the repeat period, so give whole bars to repeat a phrase. By default the first copy starts at end_step (right after the range); give to_step to place it elsewhere. Notes already present at the same pitch and step are not duplicated. The original notes stay.

start_step.description: First step of the range to copy (1 step = a 16th note; decimals allowed).

end_step.description: End of the range (exclusive; decimals allowed). A note that starts exactly here is not in the range.

pitches.description: Only copy these pitches. Omit for every pitch.

selected_only.description: true to copy only the notes selected in the piano roll.

to_step.description: Where the first copy starts (decimals allowed). Default: end_step.

tools.name: set_velocity
tools.label: ノートの強さを変える
tools.description: Change how hard notes are played (velocity, 1 to 127; notes without one play at 96). Give velocity to set them all to that value, velocity with end_velocity for a gradual change from the first note to the last (crescendo or diminuendo), or delta to add to each note's current velocity. Which notes: those that start in [start_step, end_step) (end exclusive; omit both for the whole track), optionally only certain pitches, or only the notes selected in the piano roll (selected_only).

start_step.description: First step of the range (1 step = a 16th note; decimals allowed). Omit (with end_step) for the whole track.

end_step.description: End of the range (exclusive; decimals allowed). A note that starts exactly here is not in the range.

pitches.description: Only these pitches, e.g. ["C4", "E4"]. Omit for every pitch.

selected_only.description: true to change only the notes selected in the piano roll.

end_velocity.description: With velocity: the velocity at the last note, for a gradual change.

delta.description: Amount to add to each note's velocity (negative to soften). Not together with velocity.

tools.name: check_diff
tools.label: お手本と比べる
tools.description: Compare the user's notes in a track with the reference notes (お手本) and get the differences as facts computed by bunri, not by you: the match percentage, counts by kind (missing, pitch, octave, extra, timing, length), the worst bars, and each difference with its bar, beat and notes. Use this whenever the user asks what is wrong, what differs from the original, or how close they are, instead of reading both note lists and comparing them yourself. track_id is the track with the user's notes (a practice track, or a part track whose own notes are being edited); the reference is found automatically, or give reference_track_id. Without a bar range, the practice view's loop range is used when the practice view is open on that track, otherwise the whole song. When the comparison matches what the practice view shows, the differing notes are also coloured on screen. Report what the result says; do not fix the notes unless the user asks you to.

reference_track_id.description: Track that holds the reference notes. Omit to use the track's own reference or its part track.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.label: 再現ガイドを読む
tools.description: Read the saved reproduction guide (再現ガイド): bunri's explanation of how to recreate the imported song, written from the song chart. It costs nothing to read. If none has been saved yet, the result says so; only the user can create one (学ぶ → ガイド), and you cannot. Use it when the user asks how to build or approach the song or a section.

section_id.description: Section id from get_chart, for a guide focused on that section. Omit for the whole-song guide.

tools.name: set_practice
tools.label: 練習の設定を変える
tools.description: Change the practice view's settings: the loop range in bars (loop_start_bar, loop_end_bar; giving a range turns looping on, at most 32 bars), whether looping is on (loop), the playback speed in percent (speed_percent; slows down without changing pitch, and only takes effect while looping), what is heard (listen: "part" the original part's audio, "self" the user's notes, "both"), and whether the reference notes are shown (show_reference). Give only what you want to change. The practice view must be open (open_practice). Use this with play for requests like "loop bars 5 to 8 slowly"; do not change the project tempo to slow practice down.

loop_end_bar.description: Last bar of the loop (1-based, inclusive).

show_reference.description: Show or hide the reference notes.

tools.name: set_metronome
tools.label: メトロノームを切り替える
tools.description: Turn the metronome click on or off. It sounds during playback.

tools.name: show_in_app
tools.label: 場所を示す
tools.description: Show the user where something is in bunri's window: opens the tab that contains it and makes the control pulse for a few seconds. The result gives a sentence describing where it is (where) and whether it is currently on screen (shown; if not, when says when it appears). Use it when the user asks where something is or how to do something they must do themselves, such as importing a song (import_song): you cannot choose files or press buttons for them. Targets: import_song, separate_parts, practice_part, chart, guide, coach (the diff check panel), synth, drum, fx, file_tab (audio/MIDI file import, microphone recording, data cleanup), play, tempo, time_signature, metronome, undo, save, open_project, project_menu, export_wav, export_midi, tools_page (file conversion tools), help, activity_log, add_track, timeline, piano_roll, midi_input, practice_loop, practice_speed, practice_compare.

tools.name: get_job
tools.label: 動いている処理を見る
tools.description: Read the long-running job that is in progress, if any (splitting the song into parts, building the song chart): its name, stage, progress and elapsed time. Call it when the user asks how a job is going. Do not call it repeatedly to wait for a job to finish.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.label: 動いている処理を中止する
tools.description: Ask the running long-running job to stop. It stops at the next safe point. Only do this when the user asks.

tools.name: separate_parts
tools.label: パートに分けて採譜する
tools.description: Start splitting the imported song into parts (vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano, other) and transcribing each one. This creates a track per part with its audio and reference notes. It takes several minutes; this tool returns as soon as the job has started, so tell the user it is running and end your turn rather than waiting. It needs a song imported in this session; if there is none, point the user to the import button with show_in_app. If the song has already been split, splitting again replaces the part tracks and the user's practice tracks: confirm with the user first, then pass replace_existing: true.

sensitivity.description: Transcription sensitivity, 0.1 to 1. Higher picks up more (and more spurious) notes. Default 0.5.

replace_existing.description: true to replace parts that already exist. Only after the user has agreed.

tools.name: export_wav
tools.label: WAV に書き出す
tools.description: Export what playback sounds like (audio clips and notes of the tracks that are not muted) as one WAV file. The file goes to the Downloads folder.

tools.name: export_midi
tools.label: MIDI に書き出す
tools.description: Export the notes of all tracks as a standard MIDI file, one MIDI track per track. The file goes to the Downloads folder.

tools.name: save_project
tools.label: プロジェクトを保存する
tools.description: Save the project. The first time, a dialog opens for the user to choose where to save; the tool waits for them. Only save when the user asks.

tools.name: move_clip
tools.label: クリップを動かす
tools.description: Move an audio clip to a new position on the timeline: to the start of a bar (to_bar) or to a time in seconds (to_seconds). Clip indexes come from get_project (tracks[].clips[].index).

clip_index.description: Index of the clip in the track (0-based).

to_bar.description: Bar whose start the clip moves to (1-based).

to_seconds.description: Position in seconds. Not together with to_bar.

tools.name: delete_clip
tools.label: クリップを削除する
tools.description: Delete an audio clip from a track. The user can undo it, but only delete a clip when the user asked for it.

clip_index.description: Index of the clip in the track (0-based).

tools.name: duplicate_clip
tools.label: クリップを複製する
tools.description: Duplicate an audio clip and place the copy right after it on the same track. The copy keeps the clip's trimmed range and fades.

clip_index.description: Index of the clip in the track (0-based).

tools.name: trim_clip
tools.label: クリップを縮める
tools.description: Trim an audio clip, or bring back what was trimmed, by moving its left and/or right edge. This is non-destructive: the audio is not changed and does not move on the timeline, only the audible range changes, so a trimmed part comes back when the edge is moved out again. Give the new timeline position of an edge: start_seconds or start_bar (the clip then begins at the start of that bar) for the left edge, end_seconds or end_bar (the clip then ends at the end of that bar) for the right edge. An edge you do not give stays where it is. An edge cannot go beyond the audio itself; it stops there and the result says so. To show the whole audio again, use audio_start_seconds and audio_duration_seconds from get_project (left edge = start_seconds - audio_start_seconds, right edge = that + audio_duration_seconds). Fades are shortened if they no longer fit. To move a clip, use move_clip instead.

clip_index.description: Index of the clip in the track (0-based).

start_seconds.description: New position of the left edge on the timeline, in seconds. Not together with start_bar.

end_seconds.description: New position of the right edge on the timeline, in seconds. Not together with end_bar.

start_bar.description: Bar at whose start the clip begins (1-based).

end_bar.description: Bar at whose end the clip ends (1-based, inclusive).

tools.name: split_clip
tools.label: クリップを分割する
tools.description: Split an audio clip into two clips at a position inside it: at_seconds, at_bar (the start of that bar), or, when neither is given, the current playback position. Both clips keep pointing at the same audio, so nothing sounds different until one of them is moved, trimmed, faded or deleted. The right-hand part gets index clip_index + 1 and the clips after it shift by one, so call get_project again before using other clip indexes on that track.

clip_index.description: Index of the clip in the track (0-based).

at_seconds.description: Timeline position of the cut, in seconds. Not together with at_bar.

at_bar.description: Bar at whose start the clip is cut (1-based).

tools.name: fade_clip
tools.label: クリップにフェードを付ける
tools.description: Set the fade-in and/or fade-out of an audio clip: the volume rises in a straight line over fade_in_seconds at the start of the clip and falls over fade_out_seconds at its end. 0 removes a fade; the one you do not give is left as it is. The two fades cannot overlap, so their sum must not exceed the clip length (duration_seconds in get_project). Fades are clip settings (the audio is not changed) and are heard in playback and in the WAV export. You cannot hear the result, so say what you set and let the user listen.

clip_index.description: Index of the clip in the track (0-based).

fade_in_seconds.description: Length of the fade-in in seconds (0 removes it).

fade_out_seconds.description: Length of the fade-out in seconds (0 removes it).

tools.name: apply_effect
tools.label: エフェクトをかける
tools.description: Apply an audio effect to an audio clip; the clip is replaced by the processed audio (undoable). It works on audio clips only, not on notes. On a trimmed clip only the audible range is processed and the result becomes the clip's whole audio (the trimmed-off parts can then only be brought back by undo); fades stay as clip settings. Effects and their params (all optional, defaults in brackets): eq {low, mid, high: -12 to 12 dB [0]}; compressor {threshold: -40 to 0 dB [-20], ratio: 1 to 20 [4]}; reverb {room_size: 0 to 1 [0.5], wet: 0 to 1 [0.3]}; delay {delay_ms: 50 to 2000 [300], feedback: 0 to 0.9 [0.4], wet: 0 to 1 [0.3]}; normalize {}; pitch_shift {semitones: -12 to 12 [0]}; time_stretch {rate: 0.25 to 3 [1], 2 is twice as fast}. You cannot hear the result, so say what you applied and let the user listen.

clip_index.description: Index of the clip in the track (0-based). Default 0.

params.description: Parameters of the effect, by name (only the ones that effect has). Omitted ones use their defaults.
